deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.finding: After excluding all formal chains and their dependency closure, the frozen three-persona dataset contains no eligible hard tasks.
deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.resolution: Keep four tasks per persona and maximize text/file/tool coverage at the available easy/medium levels; do not borrow formal targets.

deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.finding: A DeepSeek-direct credential was added before any benchmark task output; the official model list exposes deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro.
deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.resolution: Use official deepseek-flash as the source model. Treat the earlier Bailian-hosted deepseek-v4-flash call only as an engineering preflight, never as an experimental sample.

deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.finding: The v1 document did not freeze user-simulator and native-judger model IDs.
deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.resolution: Use qwen3.8-max-0902 for both roles with temperature 0, record this as a protocol amendment, and keep native evaluator output separate from continuity judging.

deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.finding: The user explicitly chose a native harness; Docker is packaging/isolation rather than a benchmark-semantic requirement.
deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.resolution: Reuse the frozen PI-Bench UserAgent, runner, evaluator, NanoBot agent loop, AppWorld APIs/MCP, task data, and workspace assets in a local venv. Replace image digest evidence with Python/package/data hashes and per-condition state snapshots.

deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.finding: No Brave Search credential is locally available.
deviationsFrozenBeforeTaskOutputs.resolution: Use a frozen unkeyed DuckDuckGo HTML search adapter for every condition and model; retain web_fetch unchanged and report the provider deviation.
